task: Заявки SCP с клиентом, сегментом, офисом и регионом по названию "{name}"
sql: SELECT sa.id AS scp_app_id, sa.name AS scp_app_name, sa.create_date AS scp_create_date, sc.id AS client_id, sc.name AS client_name, bs.id AS segment_id, bs.name AS segment_name, o.id AS office_id, o.office_name AS office_name, o.office_code AS office_code, dd.id AS region_id, dd.nameregion AS region_name, sa.lim_sum, sa.gsl_limit, sa.is_state_program, sa.afp_state_id AS state_id FROM public.scp_application sa LEFT JOIN public.sys_company sc ON sa.initiator_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN public.business_segment bs ON sa.scp_business_segment = bs.id LEFT JOIN public.offices_psb o ON sa.ca_rout_office_id = o.id LEFT JOIN public.dict_div_presence dd ON sa.deleg_region_id = dd.id WHERE sa.name ILIKE '%{name}%' ORDER BY sa.create_date DESC LIMIT 100;

task: Заявки SCP с pricing, продуктом, типом кредита и AMD‑продуктом по названию продукта "{name}"
sql: SELECT sa.id AS scp_app_id, sa.name AS scp_app_name, sa.create_date AS scp_create_date, sa.lim_sum, sa.gsl_limit, pp.id AS pricing_id, pp.cr_amount AS pricing_cr_amount, pp.scp_calc_rate_val AS pricing_rate, pp.gsl_limit AS pricing_gsl_limit, dp.id AS product_id, dp.name AS product_name, dp.max_sum_credit, dp.min_sum_credit, dp.credit_interest_rate, dp.loan_terms, tl.id AS type_loan_id, tl.name AS type_loan_name, amd.id AS amd_product_id, amd.scp_general_amount AS amd_general_amount, amd.product_term AS amd_product_term FROM public.scp_application sa LEFT JOIN public.product_pricing pp ON sa.pricing_id = pp.id LEFT JOIN public.dict_product dp ON pp.app_product_id = dp.id LEFT JOIN public.type_loan tl ON pp.type_loan_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN public.scp_amd_product amd ON pp.amdp_parent_product_id = amd.id WHERE dp.name ILIKE '%{name}%' ORDER BY sa.lim_sum DESC LIMIT 100;
